title: Remote viewers describe the anomaly as a constructed gold energy source

tellings.quote: Oh, that is constructed and it's some of us have it made of gold.

plain: In 2025, remote viewers, people who say they can describe faraway places with their minds alone, reportedly said that an unusual shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea was built by someone and works as an energy source, partly made of gold. Dennis Asberg, the treasure hunter whose team found the shape, says this was what the remote viewers Joe McMoneagle and Angela Ford told him: "that is constructed and it's some of us have it made of gold."
